question.prompt: Jose is \(4\) years younger than Zack. Zack is \(3\) years older than Inez. Inez is \(15\) years old. How old is Jose?

solutions.explanation:
Start with Inez's known age. Zack is \(3\) years older, so he is \(15+3=18\) years old. Jose is \(4\) years younger than Zack, so Jose is
\[
18-4=\boxed{14}\text{ years old},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Follow the age comparisons
